LoginOIDC.SettingDisablePasswordConfirmationHelp: Certain administrational tasks require a password confirmation. When administrators are using this plugin and do not have a password they could confirm, this option can be used to skip the dialogue, when signed in via LoginOIDC
LoginOIDC.SettingDisablePasswordLogin: Disable password login for linked users
LoginOIDC.SettingDisablePasswordLoginHelp: Users linked to the OpenID Connect provider can only sign in via the provider: password login, creating app tokens with the password and password resets are disabled for them. Superusers are exempt while external login is disabled for superusers. Keep an unlinked superuser in case the provider is unavailable.
LoginOIDC.SettingDisableDirectLoginUrlHelp: When checked, users have to inititate the login via the Matomo login page. Otherwise the login button can be embedded in third-party services.
LoginOIDC.SettingAllowSignup: Create new users when users try to log in with unknown OIDC accounts
LoginOIDC.SettingRequireVerifiedEmail: Only allow sign-up with verified email addresses
LoginOIDC.SettingRequireVerifiedEmailHelp: New users are only created if the provider confirms that the email address is verified (claim 'email_verified'). Otherwise users could enter someone else's address, e.g. to pass the domain restriction. Uncheck only for providers which do not send this claim, e.g. GitHub, and only if they verify email addresses themselves.
LoginOIDC.SettingBypassTwoFa: Disable second factor when sign in with OIDC
LoginOIDC.SettingAuthenticationNameHelp: Name of the authentication source which will be displayed on the login screen.
LoginOIDC.SettingButtonColorHelp: Optional background color of the login button as hex value, e.g. #f97316. The text color is chosen automatically for best contrast.
LoginOIDC.SettingIssuerUrl: Provider domain or issuer URL (OpenID Connect discovery)
LoginOIDC.SettingIssuerUrlHelp: Matomo reads the endpoints from the provider's discovery document (/.well-known/openid-configuration). Enter the domain, e.g. 'idp.example.com', or the issuer URL if it contains a path, e.g. 'https://keycloak.example.com/realms/matomo'. Leave empty to enter the endpoints manually, e.g. for GitHub.
LoginOIDC.SettingEndSessionUrlHelp: After logging out, the user is redirected to this URL to end the session at the provider. If you are unsure, just leave this field empty.
LoginOIDC.SettingUserinfoIdHelp: Name of the unique user id field in the userinfo response. Usually for OpenID Connect services like Auth0 this is 'sub'. Github provides the user id in 'id'.
LoginOIDC.SettingRedirectUriOverrideHelp: In some cases it might be useful to manipulate the redirect uri which is given to the OpenID Connect provider. If you are unsure, just leave this field empty.
LoginOIDC.SettingAllowedSignupDomainsHelp: List of email domains which should be allowed to create new accounts. Multiple domains have to be separated by line breaks. When empty, any email domain will be accepted.
LoginOIDC.SettingAutoLinkingHelp: Enables auto linking of accounts which have the same user id in Matomo and the OIDC provider
LoginOIDC.OIDCIntro: This allows you to sign in using an external authentication service.
LoginOIDC.AccountLinked: Your account is currently linked (Remote User ID: %1$s).
LoginOIDC.AccountNotLinked: Your account is currently not linked.
LoginOIDC.ExceptionNotConfigured: LoginOIDC has not been configured yet.
LoginOIDC.ExceptionUserNotFoundAndSignupDisabled: User not found. OAuth registrations are disabled.
LoginOIDC.ExceptionUserNotFoundAndNoEmail: User not found. User could not be created because the OAuth service did not return an email address.
LoginOIDC.ExceptionUserNotFoundAndEmailNotVerified: User not found. User could not be created because the OAuth service did not confirm the email address as verified.
LoginOIDC.ExceptionAllowedSignupDomainsValidationF: Validation failed for the list of domains allowed for user creation.
LoginOIDC.ExceptionAllowedSignupDomainsDenied: The domain is currently not activated for account creation.
LoginOIDC.ExceptionAlreadyLinkedToDifferentAccount: The remote OAuth user is already linked to another account.
LoginOIDC.ExceptionLinkRequiresPasswordConfirmatio: Linking requires a recent password confirmation. Please start linking from your security settings.
LoginOIDC.ExceptionPasswordLoginDisabled: Password login is disabled for this account. Please sign in via single sign-on.
LoginOIDC.ExceptionButtonColorValidationFailed: The login button color has to be a hex color like #f97316.
LoginOIDC.ExceptionDiscoveryFailed: OpenID Connect discovery failed for %1$s: %2$s. Check the domain or issuer URL, or leave it empty and enter the endpoints manually.
